Support on Body parts 身體部位支撐
Shoulder Sling/Arm Sling
• Protect arm after injury to shoulder/
elbow.
• Facilitate healing since keep position +
avoid movements
• After shoulder operation eg rotator cuff
肩背帶/手臂吊帶
• After stroke to prevent subluxation
• 肩膀/肘部受傷後保護手臂。
• 促進癒合，因為保持姿勢+避免移動
• 肩部手術後，例如肩袖肌肉
• 中風後預防半脫位

Carpal Tunnel Wrist Brace 腕管腕帶
Aim
• stabilize wrist in “Neutral” position so to
minimize pressure on the median nerve
• “rest” from movements
• reduce pain & numbness at affected palm & fingers
• could wear during sleep
目的
• 將手腕穩定在“中立”位置，以盡量減少對正中神經的壓力
• 從運動中“休息”
• 減輕受影響手掌和手指的疼痛和麻木
• 睡覺時可以佩戴

Back Brace 背部支架(腰封)
• Add “Stability” with better awareness on the
posture.
• Limit movement.
• Minimize risk of injury eg during patient
transfer/ other manual handling tasks.
** NOT for continuous wearing
• 添加“穩定性”，更好地了解姿勢。
• 限制運動。
• 最大限度地降低受傷風險，例如在患者轉移/其他手動
搬運任務期間。
** 不適合連續佩戴
